description:
Spacious Double Room with Ensuite & Private Kitchenette in Popular BS3
Double Room | Ensuite | Private Kitchenette | Bills Included* | Shared Kitchen | Landlord flexible on furnishings | Available NOW

Looking for a room that offers a little more independence? This spacious double room on Stackpool Road comes complete with its own private kitchenette and ensuite shower room, making it an excellent choice for professionals seeking comfortable and convenient living.

Available from NOW, this well-presented room combines privacy with the benefits of shared accommodation in a fantastic BS3 location.

Step inside and you'll find:

A generously sized double bedroom with plenty of room to relax and unwind
Your own private ensuite shower room
A private kitchenette within the room, perfect for preparing light meals and enjoying added independence
Access to a communal kitchen within the property for additional cooking facilities
Neutral décor throughout, ready for you to make the space your own
Landlord flexible on furnishings 
A sought-after BS3 location close to local shops, cafés, pubs, restaurants and transport links

Situated on Stackpool Road, you'll be perfectly positioned to enjoy everything South Bristol has to offer, with easy access to the City Centre and nearby amenities.

All bills are included within the rent, with the exception of electricity, which is payable by the tenant.

EPC Rating: E
Deposit: £1,096.15

A fantastic opportunity to secure a spacious room with its own ensuite and kitchenette in one of Bristol's most popular locations.

*Electricity payable by the tenant. All other bills included.
